original_test_intent: Inject the intended MP1/SMU uncorrectable firmware error, verify the prescribed immediate warm reset and fresh MP1-specific BERT/CPER record, then prove SMU telemetry/control and host stability after boot.
original_method: Map MP1 errorindex0 and socket coverage; approve tuple and threshold/reset semantics; capture raw BERT/reset-status baseline; inject once under OOB console; timestamp reset, firmware and OS boot; decode a fresh MP1 UCE record; check sensors, thermal/power/clock control and host workload; restore BIOS/HDT state.
manual_activity: The FAE approves MP1 index/tuple and reset policy, performs one UCE injection under OOB capture, recovers the host and verifies SMU-managed services before restoring settings.
required_inputs: MP1/SMU block, errorindex0 and socket/package coverage map
Vendor semantics for errormode1, enablemcapolling0 and errortype1
MCA threshold FF5/FFE and Reset After Sync-Flood relevance plus raw restore values
Fresh MP1-specific MCA/BERT/CPER/WHEA and reset-cause fields
Reset, firmware, boot and OS-report deadlines for each supported OS
SMU sensor/thermal/power/clock health limits, aborts, OOB recovery and restoration
safety_requirements: Dedicated SUT with independent BMC/serial console and controlled thermal/power state
Preserve BERT, SEL and reset-cause baseline before any approved clear
Inject once only with boot-loop recovery and firmware-service validation ready
Abort on wrong source, absent/improper reset, boot failure, stale/missing durable record, sensor/control loss or thermal excursion
No automatic retry/reset; restore settings and verify negative persistent-fault state
agent_execution_scope: Validate tuple, threshold/reset policy, durable oracle, deadlines and controller-health plan
Collect read-only raw status, OOB/BERT/CPER/SEL, boot timeline, sensor and power/thermal/clock health
Do not choose index/socket, alter BIOS/HDT, inject, reset, recover, retry or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve MP1 tuple and socket scope
Approve reset/durable evidence and controller-health oracle

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A post-boot generic SMU/firmware-error grep cannot prove that errorindex0 produced the MP1 UCE or that the collected record is fresh after the immediate reset.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After tuple and reset-cause approval, inject once under uninterrupted OOB capture and correlate a fresh MP1 UCE record with bounded reboot and restored SMU control functions.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: smupsp, socket0, errormode1, enablemcapolling0, errorindex0, errortype1, immediate reset, FFE threshold, three OS families and 15/20-minute values remain preserved but gated.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform a single source-identified MP1 UCE with continuous reset capture, fresh persistent evidence and post-boot firmware-service checks.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds index decoding, reset-cause freshness, time-bounded boot, SMU service health and raw rollback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A reboot plus any BERT line cannot establish MP1 source identity or controller recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The UCE can cause repeated reset, prevent boot or leave thermal/power management impaired.

project_override_considerations: On multi-socket systems, socket0-only coverage needs an explicit applicability decision. The generic correctable Criteria line is retained as alternate-severity text but must not replace the UCE BERT/reset acceptance path.
expected_evidence: MP1 block/index/socket map and approved tool/spec identity
Raw RAS/HDT, reset-cause, BERT and SMU-service baseline
Exact command with OOB immediate-reset/firmware/boot timeline
Healthy sensors, thermal/power/clock control and bounded host workload after boot

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The UCE title, errortype1, immediate reset and BERT branch are internally aligned. The generic CE line is separable, but tuple meanings, timing, source fields and recovery criteria remain incomplete engineering inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The source defines a coherent MP1 UCE intent and executable literal tuple. Missing platform decisions gate execution, not static review.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 82 Wistron-System RAS-00802-V003: define MP1 block/errorindex0, socket coverage and smupsp errormode1/enablemcapolling0/errortype1 semantics; specify FF5/FFE and SyncFlood relevance, fresh MP1-specific MCA/BERT/CPER/WHEA plus reset-cause evidence, reset/firmware/boot/OS deadlines, SMU telemetry/power/thermal/clock recovery, aborts, OOB recovery and restoration.

review_improvement: Builds an MP1-specific persistent reset correlation and firmware-control recovery contract without misusing the generic correctable branch.
independent_technical_reasoning: The OS cannot collect volatile evidence while the UCE resets the host, so BERT/CPER, SEL and OOB timing must be the correlation chain. Because MP1 manages platform controls, returning to a login prompt is insufficient: sensor publication and power/thermal/clock functions must operate normally. Index and mode semantics remain vendor-defined and cannot be inferred from the adjacent CE case.
